UserWorkspace.title: UserWorkspace
UserWorkspace.description: Root workspace metadata and study timer state for an authenticated student.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

contentHash.description: Deterministic hash of the full StudyDatabase content.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the persisted StudyDatabase.

sectionCount.description: Total number of active StudyDbRecord documents in the subcollection.

timerState.description: Current electronic study timer and Pomodoro state.

revision.description: Monotonic revision counter for optimistic concurrency control across devices.

chunkHashes.description: Map of dbRecords document IDs to contentHash strings for differential real-time loading.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated.

StudyDbRecord.title: StudyDbRecord
StudyDbRecord.description: Native Firestore map chunk representing a section or slice of the user's StudyDatabase.

ownerId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the record owner.

section.description: Name of the StudyDatabase section (e.g., questions, laws, schedule, preferences).

chunkIndex.description: Zero-based index of this chunk within the section.

chunkTotal.description: Total number of chunks for this section.

contentHash.description: Deterministic hash of this chunk's payload.

payload.description: Native Firestore map containing the structured records for this chunk.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this record chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when this record chunk was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores root workspace metadata and timer state for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/dbRecords/{recordId}.description: Stores native map chunks for all 29 sections of the user's StudyDatabase.
